description: Stationnement – place des deux roues motorisées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Levallois. Lists of places reserved for the parking of two motorised wheels in the territory of the Municipality of Levallois. Coverage: Ville de Levallois. The portal shows the English title as "Parking — place of the two motorised wheels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Levallois. Its keywords include deplacement, places, arceau, deux-roues, localisation, stationnement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
